text: 创业板指、科创50均跌超3%，沪指跌超1%，深成指跌2.47%，算力硬件、半导体芯片、贵金属等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股近4300只
text_en: Both ChiNext and STAR 50 fell over 3%, Shanghai Composite down over 1%, Shenzhen Component down 2.47%, with computing hardware, semiconductor chips, and precious metals leading declines; nearly 4,300 stocks fell across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets
